subject.title: fix(gateway): force-discard ACP runtime after cancel/close timeout

question: Should this PR require live stuck-ACP recovery evidence, or may the deterministic hanging-operation tests receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: Repository policy normally requires real after-fix behavior proof for external runtime PRs, but the patch has unusually strong deterministic concurrency coverage and the contributor reports that a sanitized remote proof environment could not be allocated.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Wait for redacted logs showing cleanup timeout, successful reset, a fresh runtime/process, and no late retired-generation output.

options.title: Accept deterministic proof
options.body: Apply an explicit proof override and accept the residual risk that real adapter or process-tree behavior differs from the tested hanging runtime.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Wait for redacted logs showing cleanup timeout, successful reset, a fresh runtime/process, and no late retired-generation output.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns ACP runtime lifecycle and recovery semantics in the area most closely associated with this owner.
